ogTitle: Hyirebo: the Bowiri festival of peace
subtitle: The festival of peace
answer: Hyirebo, also called the Boriwiman festival, is the state festival of Bowiri Amanforo in the Biakoye District of the Oti Region. It celebrates peace and the sanctification of the state, and closes the traditional year. It is held in the first week of April.

schema.description: Festival of peace that closes the traditional year at Bowiri Amanforo.

sections.title: Why Hyirebo
sections.html: The ancestors left an existing Mmowere state to found a new one, and named the land Mmowere Amanforo, “the new state of Mmowere”. They set up Hyirebo to proclaim it, and it has been kept ever since, for peace, unity and the progress of the state.[[1]]

days.label: Sunday
days.title: Homecoming
days.html: People who live away come home.[[1]]

days.label: Monday
days.title: Work together
days.html: Meetings and communal labour in every town.[[1]]

days.label: Tuesday
days.title: Great taboo day
days.html: No heavy farm work; only family and clan meetings.[[1]]

days.label: Wednesday
days.title: Wailing
days.html: Morning rites in every clan and wailing for fallen heroes and loved ones.[[1]]

days.label: Thursday
days.title: Feasting
days.html: Families feast, and animals are slaughtered.[[1]]

days.label: Friday
days.title: White clay and the durbar
days.html: At dawn families bathe in the river, women and children first, then smear white clay on their bodies. Clan and town processions come to the durbar ground with drums and festival songs, for speeches, an appeal for development funds and dancing until evening.[[1]]

sections.title: Good to know if you go
tips: Where: Bowiri is in the Biakoye District. See the Oti page for places nearby.
Also in Bowiri: Fussikur, the migration festival, between February and March.
Check the dates: the traditional council sets them each year. Local radio and the national press carry the announcement.
Respect the rites: some rituals are sacred and not for cameras. Ask before photographing chiefs, priests or anyone taking part, and follow what the ushers ask.

faq.a: The festival of peace of Bowiri Amanforo in the Oti Region, which closes the traditional year.
In the first week of April.
